title: usermacro.update
description: Update existing host macros. The hostmacroid property must be defined for each host macro, all other properties are optional and only passed properties will be updated.

hostid.description: ID of the host that the macro belongs to.

type.description: Type of macro. Possible values: 0 - (default) Text macro; 1 - Secret macro; 2 - Vault secret.
